notes.title: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul Demo Released!
notes.notes:
👋  Exciting news everyone! 

We are really happy to announce the release of the demo of our latest adventure game "Alchemist: Journey of the Soul"! 

We have been working on it for quite some time now and we can finally share it with you, in order to get your precious feedback!

You can wishlist ❤️  the game and play the demo here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115240?utm_source=Steam&utm_campaign=DEMOannouncement

Thank you,
OnSkull Games

notes.title: Unsafe is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce our latest game "Unsafe", a horror coop game. We have been working on Unsafe for quite a few months now and we have finally decided to share it with you!

You can wishlist the game here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756160/Unsafe/]Unsame on Steam[/url]

As we get closer to our early access release date, we will be posting more information / media from the game and keep you up to date with our progress. In the mean time, you can ask any questions you have on the Discussions page, we will do our best to answer!

We can't wait to see where this game goes with your help and suggestions!

Thank you
OnSkull Games

notes.title: Fovos VR is out!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27357239/41cfca0104a7469b8daaf980a3bca369dfe69fcf.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

It has been a long while, our apologies for that. Over the past 2 years (wow, two years have gone by already!) we have worked on a lot of games. Our team has changed multiple times, growing ever larger, and we have changed our minds over and over again on all sorts of issues.

[i][b]We have decided to release FovosVR and to stop working on it.[/b][/i]

Needless to say, we have come a long way, and so have our games. We have switched our attention to different kinds of games, as evident by our game releases, but at the same time we felt that Fovos VR no longer fairly represents our capabilities. This is why we revamped the whole experience, added any new content we had prepared and are now exiting early access and releasing the game.

We hope these changes make the game a positive experience for anyone new to VR, for the low-low price of free, as we believe that is important for the industry to grow.

For anyone who, for whatever reason, wants to play the old version, that will be available under the "oldschool" branch of the game's build.

Thank you for being with us, please look forward to our new projects, we hope to see you there!

-OnSkull Games

notes.title: Changes are coming...
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It’s been a while and we have been hard at work with Fovos VR, while also working on our next game! We have received plenty of feedback, we have read all your comments, good and bad and we thank you all for that. We are in the process of reworking most aspects of the game and we are expecting to release an update in the near future (~1 month) that will incorporate all these changes. Here’s a short list of them:

[list]
[*]New Weapons! More guns was one of the most requested items and so we deliver! Expect a shotgun, an assault rifle and a revamped pistol.
[*]Enemy models are being recreated from the ground up. More attacks, more animations, more enemy types, more tactics, more, more, more!
[*]Environments! Shiny (well, dusty) new places for you to chase and be chased around? Did we mention movement? That’s true! ;)
[/list]

But of course, we did not come empty handed, so here’s some teasers for you to enjoy until the update arrives!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27357239/977bad9cd0498ae5c394fae3f0aae45b00e53135.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27357239/59ad8b44feb85194befc9cffbbfe1c3f2665b7e7.png[/img]

notes.title: FovosVR Update v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Just a small set of fixes, we are working on refining the enemies, rebuilding them from the ground up to be more aggressive, smart and have more animations. Stay tuned for that.

Here is a list of [b][i]changes[/i][/b]:
[list]
[*] Added visible sights to the gun.
[*] Fixed a bug where the gun and laser would sometimes collide with invisible objects.
[*]Slightly changed gun position.
[*]Raised seated position in driving scene.
[/list]

Once again, thank you for trying the game out, we are open to your comments and recommendations.

notes.title: FovosVR Update v1.0.1
notes.notes:
During these last few days we received some (mostly) helpful comments and suggestions and made some changes to the game, mostly corrections and adjustments, while we are still working on improving the overall gameplay experience and survival mode.

Here is a list of [b][i]changes[/i][/b]:
[list]
[*]Improvements on the collision detection of the gun on lower frame-rates.
[*]Added an options menu for changing graphic presets and volumes (left controller menu button).
[*]Reduced the duration of the first story sequence, people seems to stop playing before they reached the rest.
[*]Added a way to skip the car intro sequence.
[*]Added/Improved some tutorial instructions.
[*]Lowered grass movement to prevent nausea when playing while closer to the ground (sitting down, etc...).
[*]Reduced zombie range, zombies now get closer to the player for a better effect.
[/list]

Thank you for trying the game out, please continue to give us your comments/recommendations.

notes.title: --- FOVOS released - Hate week announced! ---
notes.notes:
Hey there!

We are the members of OnSkull Games and we are excited to release FovosVR on Steam! Our market research has shown that some common features in AAA title releases nowadays include: broken servers, horrible bugs and global internet disappointment. Since this seems to be very important, we will try our best to have the same in FovosVR! Don't worry though, we definitely will patch things up [strike]with a 50$ DLC someday[/strike] really fast and really free - because we know that's what all the cool kids do!

We need your help though! You need to:

[olist]
[*]Play the game
[*]Find what you think really sucks
[*]Tell us!
[/olist]

Easy right? You [strike]hatefully type offenses against[/strike] give feedback for our game and we fix it! Just make sure you list the actual PROBLEM somewhere in there! Not clear enough? [strike] Are you kidding me? [/strike] Let's see some helpful examples!

Bad:
[quote]
"This game sucked! PC MASTER RACE 4 LIFE"[/quote]
[quote]
"Worst thing to come out since that vampire vs werewolf chick flick"[/quote]
[quote]
"My grandma can't even play this - 2/10"[/quote]

Good:
[quote]
"This game sucked. [b][i]The graphics [/i][/b]seemed worse than a console port! PC MASTER RACE 4 LIFE"[/quote]
[quote]
"[b][i]The script [/i][/b]was even worse than that vampire vs werewolf chick flick"[/quote]
[quote]
"My grandma can't even see the enemies because[b][i] it's too dark[/i] [/b]- 2/10"[/quote]
